literal: On this mountain above, one may be finally entrusted."
idiomatic: On this mountain above, one may be finally entrusted."

literal: Therefore she was buried there.
idiomatic: Therefore she was buried there.

literal: A separate rear-chamber temple was built at Guo Mountain; a stele was erected praising virtue.
idiomatic: A separate rear-chamber temple was built at Guo Mountain; a stele was erected praising virtue.

literal: Taiwu's Empress Helian was Qu Gui's daughter.
idiomatic: Taiwu's Empress Helian was Qu Gui's daughter.

literal: When Taiwu pacified Tongwan he took the empress and two younger sisters, all as noble ladies; later she was established empress.
idiomatic: When Taiwu pacified Tongwan he took the empress and two younger sisters, all as noble ladies; later she was established empress.

literal: At the beginning of Wencheng she died and was buried attached at Jinling.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Wencheng she died and was buried attached at Jinling.

literal: Taiwu Jing'ai Empress He was a man of Dai.
idiomatic: Taiwu Jing'ai Empress He was a man of Dai.

literal: At first she was lady; she bore Jingmu.
idiomatic: At first she was lady; she bore Jingmu.

literal: In the first year of Shenqi she died; posthumously made noble consort; buried at Jinling in Yunzhong.
idiomatic: In the first year of Shenqi she died; posthumously made noble consort; buried at Jinling in Yunzhong.

literal: Later posthumous title and honorific were raised; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: Later posthumous title and honorific were raised; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

literal: Jingmu Gong Empress Yujiulü was younger sister of Prince of Hedong Pi.
idiomatic: Jingmu Gong Empress Yujiulü was younger sister of Prince of Hedong Pi.

literal: In youth for talent she was chosen into the eastern palace.
idiomatic: In youth for talent she was chosen into the eastern palace.

literal: She won favor, bore Wencheng, and died.
idiomatic: She won favor, bore Wencheng, and died.

literal: When Wencheng took the throne, posthumous title and honorific were raised; buried at Jinling in Yunzhong; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, posthumous title and honorific were raised; buried at Jinling in Yunzhong; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

literal: Also Wencheng's wet-nurse Lady Chang, originally of Liaoxi, entered the palace through circumstances, nursed the emperor, and had toil in protecting him.
idiomatic: Also Wencheng's wet-nurse Lady Chang, originally of Liaoxi, entered the palace through circumstances, nursed the emperor, and had toil in protecting him.

literal: When Wencheng took the throne, she was honored as Protecting Empress Dowager, soon Grand Empress Dowager, announced at suburban temples.
idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, she was honored as Protecting Empress Dowager, soon Grand Empress Dowager, announced at suburban temples.

literal: In the first year of Heping she died.
idiomatic: In the first year of Heping she died.

literal: An edict ordered great mourning throughout the realm for three days; posthumous title Zhao.
idiomatic: An edict ordered great mourning throughout the realm for three days; posthumous title Zhao.

literal: Buried at Mojishan in Guangning—commonly called Cock-crow Mountain—the empress dowager's last wish.
idiomatic: Buried at Mojishan in Guangning—commonly called Cock-crow Mountain—the empress dowager's last wish.

literal: Following Empress Dowager Hui's precedent, a separate sleeping temple was set up; two hundred families guarded the tomb; a stele praised virtue.
idiomatic: Following Empress Dowager Hui's precedent, a separate sleeping temple was set up; two hundred families guarded the tomb; a stele praised virtue.

literal: Wencheng Civilizing Empress Feng was a man of Xindu in Changle.
idiomatic: Wencheng Civilizing Empress Feng was a man of Xindu in Changle.

literal: Father Lang, Inspector of Qin and Yong provinces, Duke of Xicheng.
idiomatic: Father Lang, inspector of Qin and Yong provinces, Duke of Xicheng.

literal: Mother Lady Wang of Lelang.
idiomatic: Mother Lady Wang of Lelang.

literal: The empress was born at Chang'an; there was a divine light anomaly.
idiomatic: The empress was born at Chang'an; there was a divine light anomaly.

literal: Lang was condemned and executed; the empress then entered the palace.
idiomatic: Lang was condemned and executed; the empress then entered the palace.

literal: Taiwu's left zhaoyi, the empress's aunt, had motherly virtue in nurturing and instruction.
idiomatic: Taiwu's left zhaoyi, the empress's aunt, had motherly virtue in nurturing and instruction.

literal: At fourteen Wencheng took the throne; by selection she became noble lady; later established empress.
idiomatic: At fourteen Wencheng took the throne; by selection she became noble lady; later established empress.

literal: When Wencheng died, by precedent on great state mourning, after three days rear-garment utensils were all burned; officials and inner palace all wept and attended.
idiomatic: When Wencheng died, by precedent on great state mourning, after three days rear-garment utensils were all burned; officials and inner palace all wept and attended.

literal: The empress wailed and threw herself into the fire; attendants saved her; after long while she revived.
idiomatic: The empress wailed and threw herself into the fire; attendants saved her; after a long while she revived.

literal: When Xianwen took the throne, she was honored Grand Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: When Xianwen took the throne, she was honored grand empress dowager.

literal: Chancellor Yi Hun plotted rebellion; Xianwen was twelve, in the mourning hut; the empress dowager secretly fixed the great plan, executed Hun, and then held court and heard government.
idiomatic: Chancellor Yi Hun plotted rebellion; Xianwen was twelve, in the mourning hut; the empress dowager secretly fixed the great plan, executed Hun, and then held court and heard government.

literal: When Xiaowen was born, the empress dowager personally nurtured him.
idiomatic: When Xiaowen was born, the empress dowager personally nurtured him.

literal: Afterward she ceased orders and did not hear government.
idiomatic: Afterward she ceased orders and did not hear government.

literal: The empress dowager's conduct was improper; she favored Li Yi inwardly; Xianwen because of the affair executed him.
idiomatic: The empress dowager's conduct was improper; she favored Li Yi inwardly; Xianwen because of the affair executed him.

literal: The empress dowager was displeased and then harmed the emperor.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was displeased and then harmed the emperor.

literal: In the first year of Chengming she was honored Supreme Empress Dowager and again held court and heard government.
idiomatic: In the first year of Chengming she was honored supreme empress dowager and again held court and heard government.

literal: The empress dowager was intelligent and penetrating.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was intelligent and penetrating.

literal: From entering the palace she roughly learned writing and reckoning;
idiomatic: From entering the palace she roughly learned writing and reckoning;

literal: on reaching supreme rank she decided the myriad tasks.
idiomatic: on reaching supreme rank she decided the myriad tasks.

literal: Xiaowen ordered the hawk-master corps abolished; its land was made Repaying Virtue Buddha Temple for the empress dowager.
idiomatic: Xiaowen ordered the hawk-master corps abolished; its land was made Repaying Virtue Buddha Temple for the empress dowager.

literal: The empress dowager with Xiaowen toured Fangshan; looking at the river hills she had a will to end there.
idiomatic: The empress dowager with Xiaowen toured Fangshan; looking at the river hills she had a will to end there.

literal: She told the ministers: "Shun was buried at Cangwu; the two consorts did not follow—must one attach far tombs to be honored?
idiomatic: She told the ministers, "Shun was buried at Cangwu; the two consorts did not follow—must one attach far tombs to be honored?

literal: After my hundred years, let my spirit rest here."
idiomatic: After my hundred years, let my spirit rest here."

literal: Xiaowen then ordered authorities to build the longevity tomb at Fangshan; also the Yonggu stone chamber, to be finally a pure temple.
idiomatic: Xiaowen then ordered authorities to build the longevity tomb at Fangshan; also the Yonggu stone chamber, to be finally a pure temple.

literal: In the fifth year of Taihe construction began; in the eighth year it was completed; stone was carved and a stele set praising the empress dowager's merit.
idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taihe construction began; in the eighth year it was completed; stone was carved and a stele set praising the empress dowager's merit.

literal: The empress dowager, because the emperor was in spring years, composed more than three hundred chapters of Admonition Songs, also eighteen chapters of Imperial Admonitions—most texts are not recorded.
idiomatic: The empress dowager, because the emperor was in spring years, composed more than three hundred chapters of Admonition Songs, also eighteen chapters of Imperial Admonitions—most texts are not recorded.

literal: The empress dowager set up Prince Wenxuan's temple at Chang'an; also the Siyan Buddha image at Longcheng—both carved stone and set steles.
idiomatic: The empress dowager set up Prince Wenxuan's temple at Chang'an; also the Siyan Buddha image at Longcheng—both carved stone and set steles.

literal: The empress dowager also decreed: inner five-temple grandsons and outer six-kin in mourning dress all received mourning leave.
idiomatic: The empress dowager also decreed: inner five-temple grandsons and outer six-kin in mourning dress all received mourning leave.

literal: Frugal and plain, she did not love ornament; she personally wore only coarse silk.
idiomatic: Frugal and plain, she did not love ornament; she personally wore only coarse silk.

literal: When stewards presented food, the tray was only a foot across; delicacies were reduced to eight-tenths of precedent.
idiomatic: When stewards presented food, the tray was only a foot across; delicacies were reduced to eight-tenths of precedent.

literal: The empress dowager once was unwell and took anluzi; the steward at dusk brought porridge—there was a maggot in it; the empress raised her spoon and got it.
idiomatic: The empress dowager once was unwell and took anluzi; the steward at dusk brought porridge—there was a maggot in it; the empress raised her spoon and got it.

literal: The emperor was then attending; greatly angered, he would impose extreme punishment; the empress dowager smiled and released him.
idiomatic: The emperor was then attending; greatly angered, he would impose extreme punishment; the empress dowager smiled and released him.

literal: From the empress dowager's holding court and monopolizing government, Xiaowen by nature was filial and cautious and did not wish to join in decisions;
idiomatic: From the empress dowager's holding court and monopolizing government, Xiaowen by nature was filial and cautious and did not wish to join in decisions;

literal: great or small, all was reported to the empress dowager.
idiomatic: great or small, all was reported to the empress dowager.

literal: The empress dowager was very clever, suspicious and cruel, able to do great deeds;
idiomatic: The empress dowager was very clever, suspicious and cruel, able to do great deeds;

literal: killing, rewarding, and punishing were decided in a moment, many not involving the emperor.
idiomatic: killing, rewarding, and punishing were decided in a moment, many not involving the emperor.

literal: Thus might and favor together shook inside and outside.
idiomatic: Thus might and favor together shook inside and outside.

literal: Therefore Qi Daode, Wang Yu, Zhang You, Fu Chengzu and others were raised from humble eunuchs; within the year they reached kings and dukes.
idiomatic: Therefore Qi Daode, Wang Yu, Zhang You, Fu Chengzu and others were raised from humble eunuchs; within the year they reached kings and dukes.

literal: Wang Rui went in and out of the sleeping quarters; in several years he was chief minister.
idiomatic: Wang Rui went in and out of the sleeping quarters; in several years he was chief minister.

literal: Rewards of tens of millions and billions, gold writ on iron tallies, a decree promising deathlessness.
idiomatic: Rewards of tens of millions and billions, gold writ on iron tallies, a decree promising deathlessness.

literal: Li Chong for capacity received office, also from favor in the curtain; secretly bestowed gifts beyond counting.
idiomatic: Li Chong for capacity received office, also from favor in the curtain; secretly bestowed gifts beyond counting.

literal: The empress dowager was strict and bright; even if there were favored attendants, she did not indulge them.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was strict and bright; even if there were favored attendants, she did not indulge them.

literal: Attendants' minute faults were beaten with the rod—often more than a hundred, at least several tens.
idiomatic: Attendants' minute faults were beaten with the rod—often more than a hundred, at least several tens.

literal: Yet she did not harbor old resentment; soon she treated them again as at first;
idiomatic: Yet she did not harbor old resentment; soon she treated them again as at first;

literal: or because of this they gained greater wealth—thus everyone clung to profit's desire and to death did not think of retreat.
idiomatic: or because of this they gained greater wealth—thus everyone clung to profit's desire and to death did not think of retreat.

literal: The empress dowager once with Xiaowen visited Lingquan Pool, feasting ministers and foreign envoys and chieftains of all regions, each ordered to dance his region's dance.
idiomatic: The empress dowager once with Xiaowen visited Lingquan Pool, feasting ministers and foreign envoys and chieftains of all regions, each ordered to dance his region's dance.

literal: Xiaowen offered longevity; the empress dowager gladly made song; the emperor also harmonized; then ordered ministers each to speak his aim—in all ninety harmonized.
idiomatic: Xiaowen offered longevity; the empress dowager gladly made song; the emperor also harmonized; then ordered ministers each to speak his aim—in all ninety harmonized.

literal: Outwardly the empress dowager treated men of renown; Yuan Pi, You Minggen and others received gold, silk, carriages, and horses;
idiomatic: Outwardly the empress dowager treated men of renown; Yuan Pi, You Minggen and others received gold, silk, carriages, and horses;

literal: whenever she praised Rui and the rest she brought in Pi to show no partiality.
idiomatic: whenever she praised Rui and the rest she brought in Pi to show no partiality.

literal: Also from her own faults, fearing others' criticism, at slight suspicion she saw execution.
idiomatic: Also from her own faults, fearing others' criticism, at slight suspicion she saw execution.

literal: Until the empress dowager's death, Xiaowen did not know who bore him.
idiomatic: Until the empress dowager's death, Xiaowen did not know who bore him.

literal: As for Li Yi, Li Hui and the like, more than ten houses were destroyed by suspicion; the dead numbered several hundred—mostly wrongful; the realm resented it.
idiomatic: As for Li Yi, Li Hui and the like, more than ten houses were destroyed by suspicion; the dead numbered several hundred—mostly wrongful; the realm resented it.

literal: In the fourteenth year she died in Taihe Hall, age forty-nine.
idiomatic: In the fourteenth year she died in Taihe Hall, age forty-nine.

literal: That day a male pheasant perched on Taihua Hall.
idiomatic: That day a male pheasant perched on Taihua Hall.

literal: The emperor drank but did not put food in his mouth for five days; mourning exceeded ritual.
idiomatic: The emperor drank but did not put food in his mouth for five days; mourning exceeded ritual.

literal: Posthumous title Civilizing Grand Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: Posthumous title Civilizing Grand Empress Dowager.

literal: Buried at Yonggu Tomb; at noon she returned; yu at Jianxuan Hall.
idiomatic: Buried at Yonggu Tomb; at noon she returned; yu at Jianxuan Hall.

literal: The edict said:
idiomatic: The edict said:

literal: Honoring the will for frugality, not extending unbounded grief;
idiomatic: Honoring the will for frugality, not extending unbounded grief;

literal: according with feeling and permitting ritual, upward reducing frugal instruction's virtue;
idiomatic: according with feeling and permitting ritual, upward reducing frugal instruction's virtue;

literal: advancing and retreating in thought, doubly using collapse's feeling.
idiomatic: advancing and retreating in thought, doubly using collapse's feeling.

literal: Also the mountain tomb's regulations had a fixed command;
idiomatic: Also the mountain tomb's regulations had a fixed command;

literal: inside one zhang square, outside cut to a cubit.
idiomatic: inside one zhang square, outside cut to a cubit.

literal: If the filial son's heart has what is not fully done, the chamber may be two zhang; the mound must not exceed thirty paces.
idiomatic: If the filial son's heart has what is not fully done, the chamber may be two zhang; the mound must not exceed thirty paces.

literal: Now because the tomb is looked to for ten thousand generations, it is again broadened to sixty paces.
idiomatic: Now because the tomb is looked to for ten thousand generations, it is again broadened to sixty paces.

literal: Alone I have failed the last will—grief increases to cutting off!
idiomatic: Alone I have failed the last will—grief increases to cutting off!

literal: The inner chamber's size, coffin and inner coffin's plain quality—no bright vessels set.
idiomatic: The inner chamber's size, coffin and inner coffin's plain quality—no bright vessels set.

literal: As for plain curtains, coarse mats, and ceramic tiles, these too are not placed.
idiomatic: As for plain curtains, coarse mats, and ceramic tiles, these too are not placed.

literal: This follows the former will and obeys the book's command.
idiomatic: This follows the former will and obeys the book's command.

literal: All following the last affairs, some followed and some violated—those who did not reach may have been startled.
idiomatic: All following the last affairs, some followed and some violated—those who did not reach may have been startled.

literal: Within the inner coffin, the dark hall—where the sage spirit rests—each has been followed and obeyed, showing frugal virtue upward.
idiomatic: Within the inner coffin, the dark hall—where the sage spirit rests—each has been followed and obeyed, showing frugal virtue upward.

literal: The rest, outer affairs not followed, to exhaust painful longing's feeling.
idiomatic: The rest, outer affairs not followed, to exhaust painful longing's feeling.

literal: Proclaim far and near, set forth to all offices, above showing frugal instruction's beauty, below showing disobedience to command's fault.
idiomatic: Proclaim far and near, set forth to all offices, above showing frugal instruction's beauty, below showing disobedience to command's fault.

literal: At end of weeping, Xiaowen wore mourning; close ministers followed in dress.
idiomatic: At end of weeping, Xiaowen wore mourning; close ministers followed in dress.

literal: Three ministers and below, outer ministers in mourning dress changed to practice dress;
idiomatic: Three ministers and below, outer ministers in mourning dress changed to practice dress;

literal: seventh grade and below removed all and returned to auspicious.
idiomatic: seventh grade and below removed all and returned to auspicious.

literal: Attached sacrifice was set at Taihe Hall; dukes and below began to attend to public affairs.
idiomatic: Attached sacrifice was set at Taihe Hall; dukes and below began to attend to public affairs.

literal: The emperor wasted away; he abstained from wine and meat for three years.
idiomatic: The emperor wasted away; he abstained from wine and meat for three years.

literal: At first the emperor was filial toward the empress dowager; east of Yonggu Tomb more than a li he built a longevity palace and had a will to gaze finally.
idiomatic: At first the emperor was filial toward the empress dowager; east of Yonggu Tomb more than a li he built a longevity palace and had a will to gaze finally.

literal: When he moved the capital to Luoyang, he himself memorialized west of the Chan for the mountain garden's place; the Fangshan empty palace was called Wannian Hall.
idiomatic: When he moved the capital to Luoyang, he himself memorialized west of the Chan for the mountain garden's place; the Fangshan empty palace was called Wannian Hall.
